first_reader_check.about: Whether a published tag on a released mathematics item is required to match the key, tested by programs that lack the tagged operation.
first_reader_check.shown: Three Holm families, never a mixed pool. Catalog 105: zero Holm, two per-cell witnesses (Regents geometry 0.323 n=279; EQAO grade 6 0.500 n=40). Strategy 67: STAAR grade-5 arithmetic closure 0.525 n=40 is the discovery Holm reject and failed powered replication (combined 0.328, CI covers chance). LM 68: Qwen 7B/14B and Phi-4 recover keys from type plus option form on withheld-quantity Algebra I/II; Phi-4 also clears geometry 0.404 n=166 vs chance and modal 0.289; Mistral is a weak solver. TIMSS knowing/applying/reasoning remain null at clustered floors 0.400 to 0.421.
first_reader_check.what_is_new: A three-family requirement census with an existential partial-input reader across two model families, including Phi-4 geometry, and a strategy discovery that does not replicate.
first_reader_check.why_a_big_deal: Accountability and research that treat a pass on those matched items as evidence of the tagged skill are reading the wrong quantity.
